# Era presets

Each preset is a locked spec. Mixing elements across presets is allowed only when the era spec declares time_capsule true and names the story (for example a 1998 site last updated in 2006).

| Preset | Name | Years | Canvas | Palette | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [A](preset-a-proto-web.md) | Proto-Web / Academic | 1993-1996 | fluid | browser-default | spec-only |
| [B](preset-b-geocities.md) | GeoCities / Angelfire / Tripod personal homepage | 1995-2000 | 600 px | web-safe-216 | kit |
| [C](preset-c-frontpage.md) | FrontPage / Dreamweaver small-business and corporate | 1997-2003 | 760 px | theme | kit |
| [D](preset-d-portal.md) | Web 1.5 portal / Y2K corporate | 1999-2004 | 760 px | full | spec-only |
| [E](preset-e-myspace.md) | MySpace profile / Xanga / LiveJournal | 2004-2009 | 800 px | full | kit |
| [F](preset-f-revival.md) | Modern revival (Neocities / small web) | 2013-now | any | full | spec-only |

Kits exist for B, C, and E, the three presets with the best-documented signatures. A, D, and F are full specs that scaffold from a blank page until a kit lands.
